// locales: App Store storefront codes. See references/pipeline-setup.md for the mapping to app codes.
// localeMap: Optional: store code -> app .xcstrings/.lproj code, only where they differ.
// screens: Ordered list; each needs a Screen case, a reproduction view, and a UITest capture line.
// captions: This skill outputs raw device screens. Marketing captions/backgrounds/frames are added downstream in AppScreens — see the app-screenshots-captions skill.
// outputDir: RAW screens. Keep separate from fastlane/screenshots (deliver's upload dir + finished AppScreens exports) so nothing gets clobbered.
